'''''How Susa Tamed Jain Farstrider''''' is a story told by [[Thom]] while performing in the manor of [[Barthanes Damodred]].{{ref/book|2|34}}

It is also mentioned by [[Thom]] during his first meeting with [[Rand al'Thor]], [[Mat Cauthon]], [[Perrin Aybara]], and [[Egwene al'Vere]].{{ref/book|1|4}}

==Parallels==

* There is an ancient city in {{Wiki|Iran}} called {{Wiki|Susa}}. It is where the events of the Biblical books of {{Wiki|Esther}} and {{Wiki|Book of Daniel|Daniel}} take place. Notably, Esther might be said to have "tamed" {{Wiki|Xerxes I|King Xeres}} and convinced him to foil {{Wiki|Haman|Haman's}} plan to genocide the {{Wiki|Jews}}.
